title: Generate and evaluate Python text
description: You can follow source fragments from an expression tree into a complete Python expression.

steps.description: The node classes store expression structure. Visitor selects a method by node class, and ast provides a Let around nested arithmetic.
The visitor renders numbers and variable names as strings. Binary nodes combine child strings with an operator and parentheses.
Let becomes an immediately called lambda. The remaining methods format conditional expressions, lambdas, and calls.

steps.question: Does eval receive the original tree or the generated string?
steps.answer: It receives py_code, the generated Python expression string.

steps.description: The recording prints (lambda x: ((x * 2) + 1))(3), then evaluates it to 7. Generation and execution occur in separate statements.
